title: Agent Passport Manifest
description: A portable, signable, verifiable definition of an AI agent's identity, capabilities, and behavior contract. Any compliant runtime adapter can consume this manifest and reconstruct a functionally equivalent agent.

passport_version.description: Version of the Agent Passport spec this manifest conforms to.

agent_id.description: Globally unique, stable identifier for this agent (uuid or reverse-dns style).

purpose.description: One or two sentence statement of what this agent is for.

behavior_contract.description: The frozen 'personality + rules' of the agent. The hash lets any runtime verify the prompt it loaded matches what was certified.

system_prompt_hash.description: sha256 hex digest of system_prompt, used to detect drift across runtimes.

constraints.description: Hard behavioral rules the agent must never violate, checked by the verification harness.

tools.description: Typed capability contracts. Every adapter must expose exactly these tools with matching input/output schemas.

side_effects.description: Declared blast radius of the tool, used for capability auditing.

capabilities.description: Declared runtime permissions, independent of tools (network, filesystem, memory persistence).

verification.description: Filled in by the verification harness after a successful cross-runtime run. Not hand-authored.

signature.description: Cryptographic proof the manifest hasn't been tampered with since it was authored.

signed_fields.description: Which top-level fields were included in the signature payload.
